# LIZZY GRANT: THE ARCHIVES

Fan archival directory for Lana Del Rey. Retro Americana, 70s editorial, cinematic melancholy.

- Site: https://lizzygrant.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/itswill00/lizzygrant

## What is this?

Atmospheric anthology from Lizzy Grant demos (2005) to Did You Know That There's a Tunnel Under Ocean Blvd (2023). Curated as a scrapbook, told as a film. Not affiliated with Lana Del Rey.

## Sections

- Hero: editorial cover + rotating quotes + Side A cassette
- The Eras: 8 chapters (2005 → 2024), each with summary and moodboard photo
- Secret Vault: 17 case files (unreleased / poetry / lore) with inspection modal
- Lyrical Tarot: 8 cards, lyric + theme
- Muses & Lovers: public relationship chapters as fan readings (Barrie → Jeremy Dufrene)
- Louisiana Now: journal (Waffle House, Coachella headline, 2024 wedding)
- Contact Sheet: 22 frames (2011 → 2025), era filters, loupe lightbox
- Discography: 9 releases, standard tracklists, singles marked, tap-to-preview

## Music & photos (legal)

- Audio: 129 genuine 30-second vocal previews in public/audio/*.mp3 (local first), then iTunes Search API, then Deezer fallback. Full songs belong to respective holders.
- Photos: Wikimedia Commons contributors (CC-BY-SA), served via upload.wikimedia.org thumb.

## Discography (9)

- Born to Die (2012): 15 tracks
- Paradise EP (2012): 8 tracks
- Ultraviolence (2014): 14 tracks
- Honeymoon (2015): 14 tracks
- Lust for Life (2017): 16 tracks
- Norman Fucking Rockwell! (2019): 14 tracks
- Chemtrails Over the Country Club (2021): 11 tracks
- Blue Banisters (2021): 15 tracks
- Did You Know That There's a Tunnel Under Ocean Blvd (2023): 15 tracks

## How to preview

Tap any track title, era cut, tarot card, or muse song. Local file plays instantly inside user gesture (autoplay-safe). Unreleased vault items show unplayable notice.

## FAQ

Q: Who is Lizzy Grant?
A: Early stage name of Lana Del Rey (Elizabeth Woolridge Grant), used for 2008 Kill Kill and 2010 Lana Del Ray album.

Q: What is the Vault?
A: 17 editorial case files documenting unreleased songs, poetry, and lore. Catalog numbers like LG-UNR-041 are fan consensus, session unconfirmed unless noted.

Q: Are previews full songs?
A: No, 30-second vocal clips only.

Q: Where are photos from?
A: Wikimedia Commons CC-BY-SA contributors, credited per frame.

## Stack

Vite + React + Tailwind + Framer Motion. Content in src/data/*.js.
